name: translate-bidirectional
title: Translate Bidirectional AI
description: Translate selected or clipboard text between a source and target language of your choice using Raycast AI, with automatic language detection. Solves a key limitation of Raycast AI Commands: they don't support conditional logic to check the current selection first and fall back to the clipboard. This extension does exactly that — merging both operations into a single command so you always translate the right text without switching between two separate commands.
author: jonnathanvb

commands.description: Translate the selected text (or the clipboard, as fallback) with Raycast AI, streaming the result with its original formatting preserved.
